answer: Anchor identity to a flowing river of verified work: an agent's standing equals its recent completed tasks, weighted by recency, so old work fades like water carried downstream. A new identity starts with a sable-dark record of zero standing and earns trust one job at a time. A single ivory-white certificate from a trusted auditor can jump-start it, but the auditor stakes its own bond on that certificate and forfeits it if the agent is later exposed as a Sybil. Splitting effort across a thousand fakes leaves each starved of standing, while buying certificates scales with the fake count.
